title: runtime: the owner-only fallback for a missing hierarchy-security provider logs nothing outside the CLI
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Filing category: out-of-scope follow-up from objectstack#34726 (draft PR #35168, Acceptance notes; premise 6972083658), filed by the seat. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is wrong

When `hierarchy-security` is required but no provider is installed, the runtime falls back to owner-only scope (`plugin-sharing` `resolveOwnerScopeIds`) and logs nothing. #35168 adds a line at `os serve` start, but a host that boots the runtime without the CLI (for example a hosted runtime) still gets no line, so an operator cannot tell why every user sees only their own records.

## Done when

The runtime logs one warning per boot (not per request) naming the missing provider and the owner-only consequence, wherever the fallback is taken; pinned.
